sources.snippet: The model is a finetuned variant of Chatterbox Multilingual, one of the leading open-source text-to-speech models. The base Chatterbox model is built on a 0.5B Llama backbone and trained on more than 500,000 hours of high-quality multilingual speech data across 23 languages, including Danish.

sources.snippet: 1. CoRal Røst-v3-Chatterbox-500m ⭐ recommended What: Danish fine-tune of ResembleAI's Chatterbox Multilingual, by the Alexandra Institute / CoRal project. State-of-the-art for Danish today. Architecture: 0.5 B Llama backbone, audio-token LM (same family as Chatterbox). Fine-tuned on 2 000+ hours of Danish on top of the 500 k-hour multilingual base.
